verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own export/import of feature flags "for easy migration", which is a first-party exit path. It covers only feature flags, and only through a single pricing-page line. The Admin API and self-hosting are building blocks or deployment options, not an export feature, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence that export covers all data (users, projects, segments, audit/metrics), documentation of the export format as open/standard, in-depth export docs, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export/import feature flags for easy migration
